meta.title: Viewport Size Tool - S-Jiffy
meta.description: View window, viewport, screen and pixel density info in real time, auto-updating on window resize.
desc: View window, viewport, screen and pixel density info in real time, auto-updating on window resize.
ui.2: Color depth (bit) indicates the number of bits per color channel, usually 24 (true color).
ui.3: Monitoring in real time, drag the window to see the values change
ui.100: Device classification is inferred from the viewport width: <600px is treated as a phone, 600–1024px as a tablet, and >1024px as a desktop.
ui.101: Scrollbar width is measured by comparing an element's clientWidth with its offsetWidth.
ui.102: CSS pixels = viewport size; physical pixels = CSS pixels × device pixel ratio (DPR), i.e. the real screen pixels.
ui.103: Window size (outer) = the overall browser window; viewport size (inner) = the available display area of the page.
